lessons.text: Never use appeal to emotion (Substituting feeling for reasoning). It cost you against Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar.
Never use appeal to popularity (Everyone believes it, therefore it is true). It cost you against Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar.
